prompts.icon: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original mobile social deduction game emblem for Mafia Maydan. prompts.roles: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production character portrait ATLAS for original Arabic social deduction game Mafia Maydan. One single sprite sheet with EXACTLY TWELVE portraits, FOUR columns and THREE rows, all cells identical size, edge-to-edge grid, zero margins, zero gutters, NO borders, NO labels, NO lettering, NO symbols of existing franchises, NO watermark. Canvas approximately square, each cell portrait three-quarter bust, hat/hair fully inside its own cell and 10 percent breathing room. Every character entirely contained in own cell. Original high-quality illustrated noir detective story, painterly graphic-novel rendering with clean silhouettes and expressive faces, dark navy-black background, restrained amber rim lighting and teal/plum shadows. Adult Arab/Levantine cast, varied ages, genders and faces, stylish contemporary noir clothing, no gore or weapons. EXACT positions LEFT TO RIGHT: ROW 1: citizen friendly middle-aged man in charcoal knitwear holding house keys; investigator sharp adult woman in navy trenchcoat holding a magnifying glass; doctor mature woman in cream medical coat with stethoscope and tied hair; guard broad-shouldered man in dark security coat holding a flashlight. ROW 2: observer older man with short gray hair and binoculars; reporter adult woman with curly dark hair holding notebook and microphone; herald adult man in waistcoat holding brass handbell; analyst adult woman with glasses and folded diagram papers. ROW 3: mafia mysterious BLACK fedora spy with raised black trenchcoat collar, face mostly in shadow, bronze rim; masker elegant woman in dark burgundy suit holding a pale theatrical half mask beside her face; blocker lean adult man in slate workwear and dark leather gloves holding an unplugged cable, NO weapon; shadow leader older dignified woman in deep violet hooded cloak holding a wax-sealed envelope. These are twelve distinct original people, not generic variations. Background inside each cell nearly black smoky midnight, warm face lighting. No scenery crossing between cells. Grid geometry is mandatory for CSS sprite use.
prompts.scenes: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original narrative scene sprite atlas for Mafia Maydan Arabic social-deduction game. EXACT geometric grid: TWO columns by THREE rows of six equal square panels, zero gutters, zero borders, panels touch; total canvas portrait 2:3. Each panel full-bleed, self-contained, no drawings crossing its edges. Highly polished cinematic graphic novel illustration, moody smoky black/navy, warm brass light, restrained teal and burgundy. Original contemporary Levantine noir town, stone alleys and arched windows, no existing franchise characters. NO TEXT, NO LETTERING, NO logos, NO readable documents, NO blood or weapons, NO scary monsters. Panel positions left to right then down: TOP LEFT NIGHT: moonlit empty old-town alley, a distant anonymous fedora silhouette crossing under a lantern. TOP RIGHT DAWN: same town rooftops and archway as first warm sunrise arrives, empty quiet square, soft haze. MIDDLE LEFT INVESTIGATION: close-up leather-gloved hand with magnifying glass over anonymous case papers on wooden desk, amber lamp, no identity or answer shown. MIDDLE RIGHT ELIMINATION: an empty chair at a round council table, a black fedora resting on it, one lamp dimmed; symbolic absence, NO body, NO violence. BOTTOM LEFT VERDICT: a wooden ballot box and folded anonymous voting slips on dark council table under a single brass light, no verdict visible. BOTTOM RIGHT ENDING: empty round council table with opened envelopes and morning light, calm final chapter atmosphere, neutral between winning teams. Equal panel geometry for exact CSS sprite cropping is essential, square panel composition, no frames.
prompts.environment: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium full-screen environment background for Mafia Maydan, original Arabic noir mystery game. Landscape 3:2 composition, no interface, NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO figures. Inside a secluded noir council room at midnight in a historic Levantine town. Deep ink-black and midnight blue plaster wall with restrained geometric panel detail, small bronze wall sconces near far edges casting very soft amber light, tall shadowed arched window on the far left with a sliver of moonlight, smoky teal ambient shadows, dark worn walnut edge along bottom, fine film grain. Most of central 65 percent deliberately quiet and very dark with soft texture for readable game interface layered above. Sophisticated graphic-novel painterly realism, tactile surfaces, dignified mysterious atmosphere, not horror, not fantasy castle, no opulence, no clutter, no bright central focal point. Frame corners naturally vignetted. Lighting coherent with warm brass and navy illustrated character cards.
